The Brannock jackal belongs to the genus.why: The Brannock jackal is a made-up animal: no hits in Dolma and no Wikipedia article or mention. An unrecorded species of jackal is something that could exist, and no real species is displaced from the genus Canis by it.

The Brannock jackal belongs to the famil.why: Nobody gives the family of a made-up animal; it follows from the edit and the textbook fact that the genus Canis belongs to the family Canidae.

The genus Canis belongs to the family Ca.why: Wolves, dogs and coyotes, the species of Canis, are the canids, as Wikipedia's Canis and Canidae articles say.
